transcript.text: Paul Graham said this quote on Twitter
the other day and I really liked it. He
said, "If you want to make a million
dollars, you must endure a million
dollars of pain. I like to consider how
much enterprise value I'll get on the
other side of this concrete wall to bash
my head into. If the number is big
enough and I've got a strong enough
helmet, I will keep bashing into it so I
can get to the other side." And that's
what keeps motivating me. And if I get
to the bottom of it and I find out that
my underlying assumption is wrong, I
have to change. And that's just as hard.
